description: Committee recommends removing St. Mark's Anglican Church from heritage protection.
This allows demolition of the 1406 8th Avenue North site.
The church and hall are in poor condition, no longer functional.

chips.text: Recommended
Roof repair for the hall was estimated at $250,000.
Decision could set a precedent for removing heritage properties that deteriorate.
Property owner explored options since 2012, but found no feasible buyer or reuse.

description: Updates criteria for heritage property designation.
Introduces a significance and integrity threshold.
Requires pre-screening on Historic Places Register.

chips.text: Recommended
Designated heritage properties will receive 5-40% property tax exemption.
Councillor questioned if new process creates an unnecessary extra step.
Property owners seeking heritage designation.
New value-based methodology replaces previous point system.
Councillor asked for clarity on who evaluates heritage properties.
Properties on heritage register lack legal protection from alterations.
Staff will formalize internal administrative standards and procedures.

description: Committee members to provide feedback on their mandate for a city-wide review.

chips.text: Recommended
Councillor notes improved committee discussions compared to previous years.
Committee members must submit feedback by September 25, 2026.
Administration promises to consult committees on review report before Council.

description: Committee proposes 2027 work plan and budget.
New process requires annual budget submission by October 1st.

chips.text: Recommended
Committee estimates $10,500 for 2027 conferences and $170 for National Trust membership.
Councillor expressed confusion about the budget submission process.
Committee unsure if it holds a separate National Trust of Canada membership.
Staff will investigate committee's National Trust of Canada membership status.

description: Committee to review and revise heritage policies.
Evaluate future of Heritage Awards program.
Research intangible heritage programs for proposal.

chips.text: Recommended

description: Committee to propose definition for intangible heritage.
This definition will be added to the city's heritage policy.
They are also reviewing "significant heritage value" term.

chips.text: Recommended
Administration previously halted pure intangible heritage inclusion due to validation issues.
Unclear who will validate and store purely intangible heritage stories.
